records.subject: You're in -- let's get Orchard Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Getting Orchard Logistics' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for writing in about dark mode -- your ticket is still open with us, and to be straight with you: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap. Same story on the weekly summary email, and I've passed your interest along.

Since our call, I noticed the first project isn't set up yet. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Want me to walk through it with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
